messages:
ryan: :rotating_light: paging oncall - multiple runtime containers on gpu-node-07 are crashlooping after a segfault in the inference engine (TensorRT path). seeing SIGSEGV in fused-kernel.so. Root of thread is this report from the deploy bot and kube alerts.

incident-bot: Pager: prod-runtime-high-error-rate triggered for cluster=prod-eu-1 namespace=redwood-runtime severity=critical. Affected service: inference-runtime. page: @sara (oncall)

sara (oncall): I'm on it. grabbing logs now.

ryan: quick summary from kubectl logs (truncated):

```
2026-03-15T10:08:22Z runtime INFO loaded model redwood/xl-13b-quant
2026-03-15T10:08:23Z runtime WARN batch size 8 > expected 4
2026-03-15T10:08:23Z runtime ERROR segfault at 0x0 (signal 11)
Backtrace (most recent call first):
  fused-kernel.so(+0x1a3f0) [0x7f2b8a1a3f0]
  libnvinfer_plugin.so(+0x8c12) [0x7f2b7f08c12]
  /usr/bin/runtime(_start+0x100) [0x559b2a0123]
```

ryan: also seeing CUDA errors in dmesg on node:

```
nvml: GPU 0: ECC error corrected
nvidia: NVRM: Xid (1b) GPU page fault
```

marta: thanks — nodes show container restartCount > 50, CrashLoopBackOff. kubectl describe shows last exit code 139. core dump present in /var/lib/crash/runtime. can we collect a gdb backtrace?

nikhil: I grabbed the core and ran gdb quickly:

```
# gdb --batch -ex "thread apply all bt full" /opt/runtime/bin/runtime core.12345
Program terminated with signal SIGSEGV, Segmentation fault.
#0  0x00007f2b8a1a3f0 in fused_attention::dispatch() at fused-kernel.cu:342
... frames showing nvtx markers and trt plugin calls
```

sara (oncall): timeline: started ~10:07 UTC, ramped over 2 minutes, alerts at 10:09. Customer-facing errors count ~1200 reqs failing in 2m window. CS reports two enterprise customers seeing 5xx spikes.

customer-success-jo: Customer X reported degraded throughput and 5xx for their embed endpoint, they opened a ticket referencing request ids. They are asking for ETA and mitigation.

ryan: quick mitigation plan brainstorm:
- drain node gpu-node-07
- cordon + evict pods to move traffic to other nodes
- disable TensorRT fused-kernel plugin via env var TRTO_DISABLE_FUSED=1 in runtime config and restart pods (fall back to slower path but stable)
- if immediate fix needed, switch canary traffic to quantized-cpu fallback pool for high-risk customers

ops-tilly: cordoning now: `kubectl cordon gpu-node-07` ; starting pod evictions with grace period 30s. will update when pods land.

sara (oncall): I want a config change instead of replacing node if possible. On the runtime side we can flip env var with a rolling restart: set RUNTIME_DISABLE_FUSED_KERNEL=1 in the deployment and scale rolling restart to sequentially restart 2 pods at a time.

nikhil: I can push a quick patch to the k8s manifest and trigger a rollout. Patch will set `TRT_DISABLE_FUSED_OPS=1` and bump image tag to previous non-trt build if available. preparing now.

ryan: while that is ongoing, can someone attach the core to eng-ml for analysis? looks like a fused attention code path with a null pointer when sequence len > 2048.

marta: core + logs uploaded to s3://redwood-incident-dumps/2471234567/ ; eng-ml and eng-runtime notified.

incident-bot: Escalation: Eng-ML oncall auto-notified: @nikhil

nikhil: rollout applied at 10:15 UTC. status: 3/10 pods restarted so far. verifying health.

sara (oncall): @customer-success-jo please tell Customer X we are rolling a config that disables the fused operator which should remove the crash. ETA ~5-7 minutes for full rollout. provide fallback endpoints if they need immediate traffic migration.

customer-success-jo: pinged customer with note and temporary reroute instructions. they acknowledged and appreciate the prompt response.

ryan: post-rollout checks: new logs show no SIGSEGV after env flip, pods healthy. error-rate down to baseline in 4 minutes. confirming no regression in latency.

marta: node-level note: investigating why GPU reported ECC/page-faults around same time - could be noisy hardware interfering with TRTensor plugin path. I'm kicking off a hardware health diag with infra.

nikhil: eng-ml will own a deeper root cause: suspect race in fused-kernel when NVML reports corrected ECC leading to unexpected memory mapping. plan: add bounds checks and more robust null guards in fused attention, and add CI with extended sequence lengths.

sara (oncall): customer impact summary for postmortem:
- incident start: 2026-03-15T10:07:23Z
- mitigation (config rollback/disable fused ops) applied: 2026-03-15T10:15:00Z
- error spike window: ~8 minutes
- affected customers: 2 enterprise tenants reported increased 5xx (total ~1200 failed requests), some internal jobs retried and backfilled

customer-success-jo: adding notes: CS reached out to Customers X and Y, both accepted temporary mitigation. asked for follow-up postmortem and timeline for permanent fix.

ryan: handing off to night eng-ml to finish kernel fix. oncall for eng-ml for next shift is @nikhil — please take the incident and own the RCA and patch rollout.

nikhil: taking the handoff. I will create an issue linking cores, logs, and an action plan: (1) reproduce with seq>2048, (2) add guard, (3) add unit test, (4) staged rollout behind feature flag. ETA for patch: 72 hours.

sara (oncall): marking incident as mitigated. leaving node cordoned until infra confirms GPU health. if anything flares, page oncall again.

marta: infra scheduled a maintenance window to run a thorough GPU diagnostic on gpu-node-07 tomorrow 03/16 02:00 UTC. will follow up in infra channel.

incident-bot: Incident status changed to mitigated by @sara (oncall). severity: P1 -> P2. `#incident-2471234567` created for postmortem tracking.

ryan: small ops ask for postmortem: include timeline, decision to disable fused ops, regression tests added, customer communication notes, and cost/latency impact of fallback path. I'll draft initial postmortem.

customer-success-jo: customers requested notification when fix is deployed. I'll manage that coms.

sara (oncall): handing off final ownership to eng-ml. good job everyone. :thumbsup:

nikhil: thanks — will follow up with RCA and PR. closing my end once the fix is merged and staged.

ops-tilly: uncordoning after infra signoff: `kubectl uncordon gpu-node-07` at 2026-03-16T02:20Z (post-maintenance).
